endorsements.name: Jaime Filson (WiK)
endorsements.label: gitDigger: Creating useful wordlists from public GitHub repositories
endorsements.description: This presentation intends to cover the thought process and logistics behind building a better wordlist using github public repositories as its source. With an estimated 2,000,000 github projects to date, how would one store that amount of data? Would you even want or need to? After downloading approximately 500,000 repositories, storing 6TB on multiple usb drives; this will be a story of one computer, bandwidth, basic python and how a small idea quickly got out of hand.
